title: Retrieved craft revealed unknown propulsion

tellings.quote: In one way we have learned that some types of propulsion for example exist that we did never never envisioned never conceived.

plain: Harold Malmgren, introduced on Jesse Michels's podcast as a former presidential advisor, says that studying recovered craft taught the United States that kinds of propulsion exist that no one had ever imagined. He mentions a man named Philip J. Corso in connection with this. If true, it would mean the government holds craft built on physics it did not know.
